purpose: Add unseen RSNA patients to development, and a separate once-only confirmation cohort. No 100 percent or clinical reliability claim.

rsna_selection.target: Calculated Normal versus Lung Opacity; other abnormal cases are never relabeled NORMAL. Radiographic proxy, not clinical pneumonia.

new_source.name: PadChest official-linked public sample
new_source.role: external pilot only, never training, calibration or candidate selection
new_source.positive: explicit pneumonia label, no contradictory normal label
new_source.grouping: one deterministic eligible frontal image per anonymized publisher PatientID

candidate.features: Same frozen MobileNetV2 RGB-float32-resize_with_pad224-GAP backbone; retain current baseline expert and source router
candidate.new_adapted_expert: Train-only standardized L2 logistic regression, equal total weight per domain/class
candidate.selection: Validation only: feasibility (Kaggle sensitivity >=0.90 and RSNA >=0.80), then worst-domain balanced accuracy, mean balanced accuracy, lower C, threshold closest to 0.5
candidate.temperature: Fit after selection on domain/class balanced validation NLL; bounded [0.2,5]; operating threshold remains 0.5

promotion_gate.failed_gate: Keep production unchanged. Preserve candidate and numerical evidence. Do not retune after opening confirmation.

limitations: New RSNA patients come from a development source, not a new institution.
Kaggle, OpenI and old RSNA cohorts were previously inspected; their gates are descriptive regression checks.
PadChest sample is tiny and has mixed physician/automatically derived report labels; cannot demonstrate clinical reliability.
Balanced quotas do not estimate clinical disease prevalence.
No labels from evaluation are used to fit weights, thresholds or calibration.
No guarantee of zero errors; reject promotion if the prespecified gate fails.
